add.name: A4-integration
add.label: A4 populated R0004 integration PCB
add.note: Direct rigid placement of the released populated KiCad PCB STEP, including all board copper and library package solids. Component face points toward the floor.

add.name: A4-spacers
add.label: Three A4 insulating spacers
add.note: Three 3 x 3 x 2 mm electrically insulating blocks between A4 and A1. Verify 0.50 mm nominal A1 component clearance on the received assembly.

add.name: A4-bond
add.label: Six A4 adhesive bondlines
add.note: Two nominal 0.25 mm insulating adhesive bondlines per support. Check assembled thickness, peel, thermal exposure and pad position on the received unit.

add.name: A5-power
add.label: A5 populated USB power-entry PCB
add.note: Direct placement of KiCad power daughterboard STEP on the A1 subassembly. The resistor thermal path, six point-to-point wires and controller net isolation need qualification.

add.name: A5-spacers
add.label: Three A5 insulating spacers
add.note: 3 x 3 x 2.7 mm electrically insulating spacers. Qualify bonded footprint, overhang and vibration.

add.name: A5-bond
add.label: Six A5 adhesive bondlines
add.note: Nominal 0.25 mm insulating adhesive bondlines on both faces of each support. Verify temperature and peel retention.

add.name: drvParts
add.label: A3 components after R1/R2 removal
add.note: Boardoza R1.0 source solids. The two R1/R2 pull-ups removed using the native PCB XY coordinates. Central bus pulls reside on A4.
